meta.note: 교재 Unit 개념에 맞춘 PFAL 파생문항

items.sentence: The dashboard provides the administrator with a clear record of active learning time.
items.prompt: provide A with B 구조에서 A와 B를 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: a clear record of active learning time
items.explanation: provide A with B는 ‘A에게 B를 제공하다’입니다.

items.sentence: The supervisor mode prevents review activity from changing the student's progress.
items.prompt: prevent A from B에서 A와 B를 차례로 선택하세요.

items.sentence: A strong reader distinguishes the main clause from an inserted clause.
items.prompt: distinguish A from B에서 A와 B를 선택하세요.
items.explanation: distinguish A from B는 A와 B를 구별한다는 뜻입니다.

items.sentence: The improvement was attributed to repeated retrieval practice.
